name: ot_qwen_tile_node-r5-COMMIT
purpose: q-tile spec r5 leaf 2 (r5-fp1): ot_qwen_tile_node = the W12 ROM tile's upper tree node (a/b/va pin flops -> 16 FP32 pair adders LAT 7 -> y/vy pin registers, fault pin register) + the tile's t_out/t_vout TOREG pin registers as a registered feed-through (t_d/t_vd on the E seam -> W pins) + ot_rst_relay (4 regions). W-edge strip 47.52 x 432 placed at tile (22.464, 345.6): its W pins sit at the tile's W-face pin offsets (n_a 356.4-455.9, n_b 457-556.5, t_out 557.5-657, n_y 658-757.5), M4. Own short clock root (~12.1k sinks); removes the node + t_out flop->port classes from the flat 34-48k-sink tile root.

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_qwen_tile_node u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/physical/ot_qwen_tile_node.sv rtl/lib/ot_rst_relay.sv rtl/hdc/ot_qwen_me_array_w12.sv rtl/hdc/ot_qwen_w12_matvec.sv rtl/hdc/ot_qwen_w12_arith.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_add_lat.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_add_lat_nr.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_prefix.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fastfp.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_delay.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fpu.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_matvec.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_mul_pipe.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_mul_lat.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_sfu.sv rtl/proto/ot_fp32_add_rne_pipe.sv && echo lint-ok

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/ot_qwen_tile_node/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/ot_qwen_tile_node/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/ot_qwen_tile_node --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_qwen_tile_node  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1
